name: Kling AI China Plugin
tagline: Generate images and videos through Kling AI China MCP
description: Official Kling AI China remote MCP with browser OAuth. Generation uses credits from the authorized China account; China and Global accounts, credits, and tasks are separate. For the official npm plugin bundle and standalone CLI, see https://www.npmjs.com/package/@klingai/plugin-cn and https://www.npmjs.com/package/@klingai/cli-cn. Setup guide: https://kling.ai/app/mcp/guide. Kling Image 4.0 is live in Kling Creative Studio and via API; MCP model availability must be checked in the live tool discovery.

install.notes: Authenticate with a Kling China account. Image or video generation consumes that account's credits.
